body:
## Goal

Remove PII-bearing model logs from Vitae while preserving useful operational observability.

## Background

Vitae handles resumes, job descriptions, prompts, and model responses that can contain personal, confidential, or employer-sensitive information. Repository guidance already says not to log raw documents, prompts, model responses, secrets, or full extracted text. Current model utility and category-detection code should be reviewed for logs that violate this invariant.

## Tasks

- [x] Inspect backend model-call, parsing, embedding, and category-detection paths for raw prompt, response, document, or extracted-content logging.
- [x] Replace unsafe logs with PII-safe fields such as IDs, counts, provider/model name, duration, status, and bounded error codes.
- [x] Add or update focused tests where practical to prevent accidental prompt/response logging.
- [x] Document any remaining unavoidable diagnostic surface and why it is safe.

## Deliverables

- Updated backend logging behavior.
- Focused privacy regression coverage or documented reason coverage is impractical.
- Short handoff notes identifying reviewed files and residual risk.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] No backend logs include raw resumes, job descriptions, prompts, full model responses, or extracted content snippets.
- [x] Operational logs still include enough non-sensitive metadata to diagnose failures.
- [x] Privacy invariant is covered by a test, lint check, or explicit review checklist.
- [x] Relevant backend tests or focused validation pass.

- `depends_on`: none
- `references`: `docs/prd/career-workflow-platform-boundaries.md`

## Goal

Make the existing Vitae planning documents and broad backlog safe for AFK implementation by aligning them with the canonical MVP vocabulary and scope.

## Background

Earlier planning created useful PRDs, ADRs, and backlog items, but later decisions narrowed the model: Seeds are outside the Catalog, `Asset` is preferred over `Item`, Obsidian is an adapter, WorkItems are not an in-product MVP primitive, Workflows are reusable definitions, and durable Records are reserved for material events. Existing broad items should be reconciled before implementation agents treat them as executable truth.

## Tasks

- [x] Review `docs/prd/career-workflow-platform-boundaries.md`, `docs/adr/0001-vitae-system-boundaries.md`, and `docs/adr/0002-career-graph-and-provenance.md` for terms superseded or narrowed by ADR-0003.
- [x] Add concise supersession or scope notes where needed, linking ADR-0003 and the MVP PRD.
- [x] Review backlog items `wi-010` through `wi-018` and mark which remain valid, need rewrite, should be deferred, or are superseded by `wi-020` through `wi-026`.
- [x] Ensure any updated planning docs preserve schema-valid frontmatter.
- [x] Update the Wayfinder map if frontier or blocked item order changes.

## Deliverables

- Updated planning docs or explicit notes showing how earlier artifacts relate to ADR-0003.
- Backlog reconciliation notes for `wi-010` through `wi-018`.
- Updated Wayfinder map if needed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Future AFK agents can identify ADR-0003 and the MVP PRD as the canonical scope sources.
- [x] Broad or stale backlog items no longer conflict silently with the MVP backlog sequence.
- [x] No document claims that in-product WorkItems are an MVP primitive.
- [x] No document claims Obsidian or SQL persistence is the product authority model.
- [x] `git diff --check` passes.
- [x] `dv backlog validate --dir backlog --fail-on error` passes.

## Implementation Notes

## Background

Vitae should model structured data and metadata independently of persistence. Obsidian Markdown, databases, graph stores, and generated artifacts are adapters or projections. The existing Obsidian Career Knowledge models for Seeds, Episodes, Technologies, Projections, Deliverables, and Applications should be leveraged rather than reinvented.

- Current-backend-to-canonical mapping notes.

## Goal

Define the MVP catalog-distillation process as reusable Workflow definitions and concrete WorkflowRun outputs.

## Background

The Episode/CatalogAsset, Seed promotion, Projection derivation, Deliverable provenance, and Application bundle prerequisites are now defined and fixture-validated. This item remains the next planning/implementation slice: no runtime workflow has been implemented by that prerequisite work.

The product verbs `harvest`, `cull`, `prime`, and `substantiate` are central to Vitae. They should be process stages, not project-management work items. A Workflow is the reusable definition; a WorkflowRun is one execution against a Profile, BookOfWork, Seed set, Target, or Application.

## Tasks

- [x] Define an onboarding/catalog-distillation Workflow with stages for ingesting SourceAssets, harvesting Seeds, culling weak material, priming promising material, substantiating claims, and publishing CatalogAssets.
- [x] Define the minimal WorkflowRun shape for MVP execution status, inputs, outputs, diagnostics, and human review points.
- [x] Define stage output contracts for Seeds, CatalogAssets, Misalignments, Recommendations, and Evidence.
- [x] Identify which stages can be AFK and which require human review.
- [x] Confirm no in-product WorkItem abstraction is needed for MVP.

## Deliverables

- Workflow definition design or schema draft.
- WorkflowRun output examples.
- Stage contract table with AFK/HITL notes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Workflow and WorkflowRun are clearly distinguished.
- [x] The four verbs have explicit inputs and outputs.
- [x] Human review points are identified.
- [x] The contract avoids treating normal app activity as backlog work.
- [x] Later agent-workflows integration can map to this contract without owning product semantics.

## Completion notes

The schema, fixtures, templates, documentation, and executable guards define a declarative catalog-distillation contract only. They do not implement persistence, a backend runtime, an in-product WorkItem, or Agent Workflows execution.

body:
## Goal

Adopt Temporal as a privacy-safe durable execution substrate for Vitae without transferring canonical domain, scoring, promotion, approval, or WorkItem authority from Vitae.

## Background

WI-022 supplies declarative workflow contracts but no durable runtime. ADR-0004 selects direct Vitae-owned Temporal integration and excludes `agent-workflows` from the product path. This epic coordinates ordered foundation work and MVP-blocking runtime adoption slices; it does not change the completed contract/fixture evidence of WI-023 through WI-026.

## Tasks

- Establish the architecture, privacy, and operations boundary.
- Build an adapter, isolated worker, ledger, and human-review bridge.
- Deliver guarded Harvest/Cull/Prime/Substantiate runtime slices.
- Implement durable adoption for downstream product slices needed by expanded MVP UAT.
- Prove UAT and Temporal Activities do not mutate canonical files/catalog under `~/Obsidian Vaults/loft/1 Projects/Job Search/`.
- Make a Cloud-versus-self-hosted adoption decision only after operational evidence exists.

## Deliverables

- ADR-0004, execution plan, and child work-item evidence.
- A tested, privacy-safe durable execution foundation.
- Durable runtime slices for target/catalog fit, deliverable generation, application automation, and Book of Work refresh.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] All children link to this epic using Doc-Vader-supported parent links.
- [x] No child makes Temporal canonical domain, policy, or WorkItem authority.
- [x] Sensitive career/model/reviewer content is excluded from Temporal and its adjacent metadata surfaces.
- [x] Runtime slices required for expanded MVP UAT are implemented without invalidating WI-023 through WI-026 contract/fixture evidence.
- [x] UAT no-write evidence harness proves canonical Obsidian vault file/catalog mutations are detected; live no-write artifact remains WI-040 evidence.
- [x] WI-040 records the operational adoption decision with required evidence.

## Exclusions

- Product-code implementation is not performed by this epic artifact itself.
- No Cloud or self-hosted Temporal choice is made before WI-040.
- Babysitter and `agent-workflows` are not added to the Vitae product runtime.

## Relationships

- `depends_on`: WI-022
- `implements`: ADR-0004
